seoTitle: Allure & Co Events | Luxury Wedding & Event Planner in London
seoDescription: Allure & Co Events is a London wedding and event planner. Weddings, proposals, baby showers, christenings and milestone celebrations across the UK. Book a free consultation.

hero.heading: Turning your vision
hero.text: Weddings, proposals and life's biggest celebrations, planned down to the last detail so you can be fully present on the day.
hero.imageAlt: Wedding reception styled with white florals and candlelight

intro.heading: An eye for the details
intro.text: Allure & Co is a London event planning studio for weddings, intimate gatherings and milestones worth marking. We design every occasion with creativity, care and a quiet touch of magic, and we take the stress off your plate so the day feels effortless from your side of it.

founder.heading: Hello, I'm Asmeret
founder.imageAlt: Planning mood board with fabric swatches and stationery
founder.text:
My love for event planning was born from a deeply personal moment. After planning my own events and wedding, I realised something unexpected: I loved the planning even more than the day itself. That feeling told me everything I needed to know.

Now I bring that same passion and obsessive attention to detail to every client. When you work with Allure & Co, you work with me personally, from our first call to your final dance. Based in London, I plan events across the UK and beyond, always with one goal: that you get to enjoy every single moment.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: For weddings, we recommend getting in touch 6 to 12 months ahead. For smaller celebrations like birthdays or baby showers, a few months is usually plenty. We always try our best to fit in last-minute enquiries, so get in touch whatever your timeline.

items.question: Do you travel outside of London?
items.answer: Yes. We're based in London and happily plan events across the UK and beyond. Travel outside London may carry an additional fee depending on location, which we always discuss openly during your consultation.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans?
items.answer: Yes. Events are a big investment, so we offer flexible payment plans tailored to your budget. We'll go through the options in your free consultation.

items.question: What happens in the free consultation?
items.answer: It's a relaxed, no-obligation conversation where we get to know you and your vision, talk through your budget and timeline, and recommend the package that fits best.

items.question: Can you work with my existing suppliers?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our packages are a starting point. We'll happily coordinate with suppliers you've already booked, or recommend trusted partners where you need them.

contact.heading: Let's start planning
contact.text: Tell us a little about your event and we'll get back to you within 24 hours to arrange your free, no-obligation consultation.
